intro: In Goldshire, Lyria Du Lac trains young warriors behind the village smithy. She teaches them to master their stances and arms.

p: Lyria Du Lac trains young warriors in the yard behind Goldshire's forge. She teaches those fresh from Northshire Abbey, judges their readiness, and introduces specialized combat techniques. Warriors take up shield and blade for Stormwind, facing the threats of Elwynn Forest.
